positions.title: Part Time Contractor
positions.description:
UniWar is a turn-based strategy game where players battle it out on the field with units of different races, building bases and using the terrain to overcome their opponents towards victory. Several modes are available along with many maps to play.

Register and play online against strangers or friends, in free-for-all or team matches, and move up in rank as you gain points for every victory.

You can have multiple active games and play them when it becomes your turn.

projects.title: SDL2 Roguelike Stealth
projects.description:
Updated AI Demo video: https://youtu.be/jPXhpA0ZKqY
Demo video: https://youtu.be/MBjP4zM8zwo

A stealth Roguelike game utilizing SDL2 and C++.

Featuring: 
* A scene stack for scene management and transitions
* 8 octant recursive shadowcasting for player vision
* 8-axis A* pathfinding for enemies
* An in-the-works Entity Component System (will be fully refactoring into this soon)

projects.title: Powerton (Ludum Dare 39 Submission)
projects.description:
Solo game project utilizing the LibGDX framework. Created and submitted in the weekend of Ludum Dare 39. Artwork provided by a friend.

Theme: running out of power.
